Ask about Tap Defense

The product

A small stand against a very busy invasion.

Tap Defense is a tap-to-shoot defense game built around quick reads and satisfying saves. Each wave sends a new mix of invaders toward the meadow. Point, tap, and fire — then decide what matters most before the next wave arrives.

Between runs, train a roster of heroes, unlock new worlds, and push deeper into a hundred hand-built levels. It is easy to start, tense to master, and designed to fit into the spare minutes of a day.

What's inside

Built around the moment.

01

Tap. Aim. Hold the line.

Point, tap, and fire. The controls stay simple so the real game can be timing, target priority, and knowing when to let a small threat pass.

02

Twelve heroes to train.

Meet a roster of heroes and build up their tap power. Every hero brings a different face and a little more firepower to the meadow.

03

Nine worlds. One hundred levels.

From the Classic meadow to Coral Kingdom, Space, and seasonal worlds, each stop remixes the scenery, enemies, and bosses.

04

A run that fits your day.

Progress saves locally, and there is no game account to create. Play a wave, put it down, and pick up where you left off.

Privacy

The published Tap Defense privacy policy is hosted separately and covers the Android app.

Tap Defense privacy policy

Opens the separately hosted Tap Defense policy.

Good to know

Questions, answered.

Is Tap Defense on Google Play?

Not publicly yet. The game is in pre-release. A verified Google Play link will be added to this page when one is available.

Does Tap Defense need an account?

No. The game saves progress locally. Google Play services may be used for purchases and advertising, as described in the privacy policy.

Can I play offline?

Yes — the game itself can load and save progress offline. Advertising, consent messages, and purchases use an internet connection when available.

How do refunds work?

Purchases are processed by Google Play. Start with Google Play's refund flow. If you are unsure which purchase is involved, email us and we will help point you in the right direction.

I found a bug. What should I send?

Email us with the subject “Tap Defense support”. Tell us your device model, Android version, what you expected, and what happened. A screenshot helps, but please leave out passwords and payment details.
